issues.title: Internal platform account identifiers exposed in user-facing route labels
issues.acceptance: No fa-/wa-/tg-/UUID identity is shown outside technical diagnostics

issues.title: Slow local models falsely fail under fragmented short timeouts
issues.acceptance: Interactive tasks run at least 180 seconds and deep/media tasks at least 240 seconds

issues.title: Task routes cannot persist per-task timeout
issues.acceptance: Primary, fallback, max tokens and timeout persist after restart

issues.title: Unexpected translation failures leave messages permanently pending
issues.acceptance: Unexpected failures settle to failed while preserving the last successful translation

issues.title: Backend translation updates do not clear renderer auto-translation queue
issues.acceptance: Current conversation updates immediately without switching conversations

issues.title: Translation job registry grows without terminal-job pruning
issues.acceptance: Terminal translation jobs are pruned while queued/running jobs remain

issues.title: Conversation analysis, vision and model verification use inconsistent short timeouts
issues.acceptance: Slow local analysis and verification complete without premature client timeout

issues.title: Fix15 global workspace scrolling and compact Facebook expressions require real Windows validation
issues.acceptance: All listed workspaces scroll naturally and Facebook lightweight expressions stay compact
